question: Consider the function $f(x)=\begin{cases}0,&\text{if }x\text{ is rational},\\x^2,&\text{if }x\text{ is irrational}.\end{cases}$ Then only one of the following statements is true. Which one is it?

options.A: $f$ is differentiable at $x=0$ but not continuous at any other point.
options.C: $f$ is continuous but not differentiable at $x=0$.
options.D: None of the foregoing statements is true.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level
